title: LEMQES — choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Raï Cassette. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Each sketch shows a Men-space customer (French) and a Women-space stylist (Arabic, RTL). Use the expand chip to read the real screens.

options.label: Raï Cassette
options.thesis: Every barber is a tape on the shelf: saturated colour fields, tall condensed numerals, names stacked Arabic over Latin.
options.viewport: Customer: ultramarine header field, barbers listed as spines whose coloured band is live status and holds the queue count. Stylist: a magenta J-card cover with the queue count at poster size and Call next under the thumb.
options.risk: Saturated fields tip into nostalgia if the type is timid or the colours multiply; held to two space fields plus status colours.

raised.raise: Every count, time and price is set in tabular figures, column-aligned across rows.
A full state vocabulary as marks: served is struck, a paused queue is hatched, disabled loses its colour.
Map pin and list row share the same spine marker, so list and map read as one space.
Each colour means one thing everywhere; saffron is reserved for 'you' — your place in a queue, your booking.

options.label: Painted Shopfront
options.thesis: The app as the shop's painted sign: bilingual lettering on enamel panels, the open state painted as big as the name.
options.viewport: Customer: barbers as small sign plates with OUVERT/مفتوح panels. Stylist: a big sign header whose status panel flips like a hanging open/closed sign.
options.risk: The most literal reading of 'barbershop' — where most runs would land; sign lettering reads as costume unless held to headings.

options.label: Gate Board
options.lineage: airport departure boards and boarding passes
options.thesis: The live queue as a departures board: rows rerank in place, a change stays lit until you've seen it, a booking is a boarding pass.
options.viewport: Customer: barbers ranked by wait time like departures. Stylist: the queue as a board with the next customer boarding.
options.case: Fuses cleanly — the queue is literally a ranked board; wins on clarity, loses on identification: airports aren't the neighbourhood shop.
options.risk: Cold and transactional; can read as a travel app instead of a local barber.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm tinted ground; the one bright colour on screen is always something you can press.
options.viewport: Customer: one-idea cards stacked in a thumb-reachable column. Stylist: a big queue card with the action colour only on Call next.
options.case: Holds clarity — instantly usable; loses identification: it could be any salon app in any country.
options.risk: Generic; hard to tell apart from existing booking apps.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: Barcode fields and monospace numerics in pure black and white.
options.viewport: Queue as a barcode field of columns.
options.case: Fuses poorly: barbers and customers don't see themselves in a data installation, and strobing hurts at-a-glance status.
options.kept: Numeric discipline: tabular figures in aligned columns.

options.label: Centre-Rail Edition
options.thesis: Two text columns around a rail of vermilion keys.
options.viewport: A reading page, not a working screen.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a reading world for a glance-and-tap tool; loses both axes.
options.kept: A complete, unambiguous state vocabulary printed as marks.

options.label: Event Catalog
options.thesis: Hundreds of stamp-size cells keyed to a hall map.
options.viewport: Barbers as a dense grid keyed to the map.
options.case: Fuses partly: list-equals-map is useful, but the newsprint world means nothing to this audience.
options.kept: List and map are one space: one marker shared by row and pin.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: A fixed colour language with one reserved colour for the active leg.
options.viewport: Near-me map with your route in purple.
options.case: Fuses partly on the map screen only; the rest of the app has no terrain.
options.kept: Each colour means exactly one thing; one reserved colour marks you.
options.risk: A map world for an app that is mostly lists.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean Material 3 booking app: white surfaces, photo-led barber cards, one brand colour.
canonCard.viewport: Search bar, photo cards with rating and distance, a standard queue card for the stylist.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
